config.description: Base URL of the Open Topo Data instance used outside USGS 3DEP coverage. Defaults to the public instance, paced to its published limits; any other URL is treated as a self-hosted instance, which must serve the srtm30m and mapzen datasets and accept at least 100 locations per request.
